requirements.notes: The request does not say whether '3+ years' applies to React or to experience overall. I read it as 3+ years of React experience, which is what a recruiter most likely means. The request gives no role title, so I inferred 'React Developer'.

shortlist.name: Grace Liu
shortlist.recommendation_reason: Meets every must-have, with evidence quoted from the resume.

verdicts.evidence: Led the migration of legacy pages to React, cutting the JavaScript bundle by 18%.
verdicts.reasoning: React is used in both roles: Willow Insurance Sep 2018–Aug 2021 (~3 years) plus Hollowbrook Health Sep 2021–Oct 2026 (~5.1 years) totals ~8.1 years, which exceeds 3.

shortlist.name: Hana Sato
shortlist.recommendation_reason: Meets every must-have, with evidence quoted from the resume.

verdicts.evidence: Built and maintained React components in TypeScript for a customer-facing web app with 600k monthly users.
verdicts.reasoning: The Arclight Mobility role (Jul 2022 to Present, i.e. Oct 2026) uses React, which is about 4 years 3 months and exceeds the 3 years required.

shortlist.name: Noah Fischer
shortlist.recommendation_reason: Meets every must-have, with evidence quoted from the resume.

verdicts.evidence: Shipped end-to-end features with React and Node.js, from database schema to UI.
verdicts.reasoning: React appears only in the Northgate Travel role, Oct 2023 to Present (Oct 2026), which is 3 years and meets the 3-year minimum.
